items.title: Single Treatment With MM120 (Lysergide) in Generalized Anxiety Disorder: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: Phase 2b randomized controlled trial of MM120 (lysergide D-tartrate) showing dose-response relationship in 198 adults with moderate to severe GAD.

items.title: Pharmacological Treatment of Generalised Anxiety Disorder: Current Practice and Future Directions.
items.summary: Expert review of current pharmacological treatments for GAD and future directions in anxiolytic drug development.

items.title: Psychological treatment of generalized anxiety disorder: a meta-analysis.
items.summary: Meta-analysis of 41 studies examining psychotherapies for GAD in adults, primarily cognitive behavior therapy.

items.title: CBT treatment delivery formats for generalized anxiety disorder: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: Network meta-analysis of 52 trials comparing different CBT delivery formats for GAD treatment in 4361 patients.

items.title: Psychological therapies for generalised anxiety disorder.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review examining efficacy and acceptability of psychological therapies for GAD compared to treatment as usual.

items.title: Efficacy and tolerability of short-term duloxetine treatment in adults with generalized anxiety disorder: A meta-analysis.
items.summary: Meta-analysis investigating efficacy and tolerability of short-term duloxetine treatment in adults with GAD.

items.title: Second-generation antipsychotics for anxiety disorders.
items.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
items.summary: Cochrane systematic review evaluating efficacy and tolerability of second-generation antipsychotics for anxiety disorders.

items.title: Passionflower in the treatment of generalized anxiety: a pilot double-blind randomized controlled trial with oxazepam.
items.journal: Journal of clinical pharmacy and therapeutics
items.summary: Double-blind RCT comparing Passiflora incarnata extract with oxazepam in 36 GAD patients over 4 weeks.

items.title: Efficacy of a multispecies probiotic as adjunctive therapy in generalized anxiety disorder: a double blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial.
items.summary: Double-blind RCT of multispecies probiotic as adjunctive therapy with sertraline in 48 drug-free GAD patients.

items.title: Buspirone: anxiolytic?
items.summary: Four-week double-blind study of buspirone versus diazepam and placebo in 60 outpatients with GAD.

items.title: Effect of valepotriates (valerian extract) in generalized anxiety disorder: a randomized placebo-controlled pilot study.
A double-blind, placebo-controlled study of a CCK-B receptor antagonist, CI-988, in patients with generalized anxiety disorder.

canonicalFacts.claim: GAD is characterized by excessive worry or anxiety about everyday events and problems with a lifetime prevalence of 17% in the general population
Current pharmacological management of GAD includes various antidepressants and anxiolytics with many patients not responding to first-line treatments
Cognitive behavioral therapy is the most studied psychological intervention for GAD with demonstrated efficacy
Second-generation antipsychotics have been investigated as potential treatments for anxiety disorders including GAD

redFlags: Antidepressant discontinuation symptoms can occur when stopping treatment
Combination of psychedelic drugs with SSRIs/SNRIs may have safety concerns

excludedAgents.name: valepotriates
excludedAgents.reason: randomized controlled trial showed no significant difference from placebo on Hamilton anxiety scale in GAD patients

excludedAgents.name: CI-988
excludedAgents.reason: double-blind placebo-controlled study of this CCK-B receptor antagonist showed no efficacy in GAD treatment

excludedAgents.name: multispecies probiotic
excludedAgents.reason: randomized controlled trial as adjunctive therapy with sertraline showed no significant benefit for GAD symptoms
